classification_policy: Classify the primary activity supported by the evidence. All ancestor conditions and exclusions apply. Use an explicit diversified category only when supported. If competing activities cannot be resolved, use insufficient_evidence. If the activity is clear but no leaf fits, use outside_taxonomy. Internal technology use does not determine industry. Evaluate the target at company scope. Prefer a supported explicit diversified path when several substantial businesses span specialist categories. Do not infer primary activity from text order, repeated keywords, or one prominently discussed division.
inheritance_policy: Child scope narrows its parent; inherit every ancestor condition and exclusion. Derive parent IDs and industry code after selecting the leaf.
industry_code_policy: Synthetic fixed six-digit strings, scoped to taxonomy version; not official industry codes. No cross-version code equivalence is implied. Abstentions have no code.

nodes.name: Financial Services
nodes.description: Provides financial services or dedicated infrastructure for financial transactions.
nodes.exclusions: General-purpose software belongs to Technology. A deposit-taking business belongs to Banking before Lending.

nodes.name: Healthcare and Life Sciences
nodes.description: Provides patient care, medical treatments, devices, testing, or biological research products.
nodes.exclusions: Software-only tools for healthcare belong to Technology; internal use of AI does not change industry.

nodes.name: Industrials
nodes.description: Develops industrial equipment or provides construction, engineering, transportation, or logistics services.
nodes.exclusions: Consumer products and computing hardware belong to their respective sectors.

nodes.name: Consumer Goods
nodes.description: Develops, produces, or markets physical products or brands for personal or household consumption.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude retailers merely reselling others’ brands, restaurants, and hotels.

nodes.name: Technology
nodes.description: Supplies computing products, reusable software, or IT services to external customers.
nodes.exclusions: Dedicated payment infrastructure belongs to Financial Services; internal use of technology alone does not qualify.

nodes.name: Banking
nodes.description: Accepts deposits and supplies banking services.
nodes.exclusions: Non-deposit lenders belong to Lending.

nodes.name: Retail Banking
nodes.description: Primarily serves individuals with deposit accounts and everyday banking.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude business-focused banks and banks explicitly operating broad retail and corporate divisions.

nodes.name: Commercial Banking
nodes.description: Primarily supplies deposit and banking services to businesses.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude retail-focused banks and broad universal banks.

nodes.name: Universal Banking
nodes.description: Explicitly operates substantial retail and corporate or investment banking divisions.
nodes.exclusions: Do not infer a universal business from a generic bank description.

nodes.name: Lending
nodes.description: Supplies credit as a non-deposit-taking lender.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude deposit-taking banks and brokers that do not extend credit.

nodes.name: Consumer Lending
nodes.description: Extends personal, installment, auto, or point-of-sale credit to individuals.
nodes.exclusions: Residential mortgages belong to Mortgage Lending.

nodes.name: Business Lending
nodes.description: Extends credit or equipment financing to business borrowers.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude consumer loans and deposit-taking banks.

nodes.name: Mortgage Lending
nodes.description: Primarily originates or funds residential mortgage loans.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude mortgage listing sites and referral-only brokers.

nodes.name: Payments
nodes.description: Enables payment acceptance, processing, transfer, or operational tracking.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude businesses merely accepting payment for unrelated products.

nodes.name: Payment Networks
nodes.description: Operates a network or scheme connecting payment participants and institutions.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude merchant-focused processors and payment operations platforms.

nodes.name: Merchant Payment Processing
nodes.description: Primarily enables merchants to accept and process customer payments.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude network operators and general treasury or money-movement orchestration.

nodes.name: Payment Operations Platforms
nodes.description: Provides dedicated APIs or platforms for business money movement, reconciliation, or payment ledgers.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude merchant checkout-focused processing and payment network operators.

nodes.name: Insurance
nodes.description: Underwrites insurance risks or intermediates insurance products.
nodes.exclusions: Insurance software without underwriting or brokerage belongs to Technology.

nodes.name: Life and Health Insurance
nodes.description: Primarily underwrites life, annuity, or health coverage.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude property/casualty underwriting and intermediaries.

nodes.name: Property and Casualty Insurance
nodes.description: Primarily underwrites property, auto, liability, or other casualty risks.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude life/health underwriting and intermediaries.

nodes.name: Insurance Brokerage
nodes.description: Arranges insurance coverage between customers and insurers.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude businesses primarily bearing underwriting risk.

nodes.name: Investment Services
nodes.description: Manages investments, executes securities transactions, or supplies investment banking services.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude deposit-led banking businesses.

nodes.name: Asset Management
nodes.description: Manages pooled funds or investment portfolios on behalf of investors.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude execution-focused brokers and deal-advisory firms.

nodes.name: Securities Brokerage
nodes.description: Primarily provides securities trading access and transaction execution.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude portfolio-management-led businesses.

nodes.name: Investment Banking
nodes.description: Primarily advises on mergers, capital raising, or securities underwriting.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude universal banks and retail trading platforms.

nodes.name: Care Providers
nodes.description: Directly delivers clinical care to patients.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude insurers, laboratories providing only testing, and software vendors.

nodes.name: Hospitals
nodes.description: Operates inpatient hospitals and associated acute-care facilities.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude outpatient-only clinics.

nodes.name: Outpatient Care
nodes.description: Operates non-dental clinics or practices delivering care without inpatient admission.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude hospitals, dental practices, and standalone testing laboratories.

nodes.name: Dental Care
nodes.description: Operates dental practices providing oral examinations or treatment.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude dental equipment and practice software vendors.

nodes.name: Pharmaceuticals
nodes.description: Develops or commercializes conventional medicines or broad medicine portfolios.
nodes.exclusions: Dedicated cell/gene or biologics-platform developers belong to Biotechnology. Broad commercial portfolios take precedence over a single modality.

nodes.name: Integrated Pharmaceuticals
nodes.description: Combines drug research or development with a marketed portfolio of medicines or vaccines.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude clinical-stage-only developers and generic-led suppliers.

nodes.name: Clinical Drug Development
nodes.description: Owns or licenses therapeutic candidates and advances them through clinical development.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude established broad commercial portfolios, pure research contractors, and dedicated cell/gene or biologics platforms.

nodes.name: Generic Medicines
nodes.description: Primarily develops or supplies off-patent generic medicines.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude branded discovery-led pharmaceutical companies.

nodes.name: Biotechnology
nodes.description: Develops dedicated biological therapeutic modalities or biological research products.
nodes.exclusions: The word biotech alone is insufficient. Broad marketed medicine portfolios belong to Pharmaceuticals.

nodes.name: Cell and Gene Therapies
nodes.description: Develops treatments based on engineered cells or genetic modification.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude conventional drug programs and research-only reagents.

nodes.name: Biologic Therapeutics
nodes.description: Specializes in therapeutic antibodies, proteins, or other biologic platforms.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude cell/gene therapies and diversified commercial pharma.

nodes.name: Research Tools and Reagents
nodes.description: Supplies biological reagents, assays, or laboratory research tools to researchers.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude clinical diagnostic services and therapeutic developers.

nodes.name: Medical Devices
nodes.description: Develops physical equipment or devices used in patient diagnosis or treatment.
nodes.exclusions: Standalone diagnostic service providers belong to Diagnostics.

nodes.name: Surgical Devices
nodes.description: Produces instruments, implants, or systems used in surgical procedures.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude diagnostic imaging and non-surgical monitoring.

nodes.name: Imaging Equipment
nodes.description: Produces medical imaging systems such as MRI, CT, or ultrasound equipment.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude imaging service operators.

nodes.name: Monitoring and Therapeutic Devices
nodes.description: Produces non-surgical patient monitoring or therapeutic support devices.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude imaging equipment and surgical systems.

nodes.name: Diagnostics
nodes.description: Provides diagnostic testing services using samples or medical imaging.
nodes.exclusions: Equipment manufacturers belong to Medical Devices.

nodes.name: Clinical Laboratories
nodes.description: Performs routine or broad clinical testing on patient samples.
nodes.exclusions: Dedicated genetic testing belongs to Molecular Diagnostics.

nodes.name: Molecular Diagnostics
nodes.description: Specializes in genetic or molecular diagnostic testing services.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude research-only reagents and general clinical laboratories.

nodes.name: Diagnostic Imaging Services
nodes.description: Operates facilities providing diagnostic imaging examinations.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude imaging equipment manufacturers and general hospitals.

nodes.name: Aerospace and Defense
nodes.description: Develops aircraft, defense equipment, or space systems.
nodes.exclusions: Airline operations belong to Transportation and Logistics.

nodes.name: Commercial Aircraft
nodes.description: Develops or manufactures complete civilian aircraft, including pre-commercial developers.
nodes.exclusions: Integrated firms explicitly spanning commercial aircraft, defense, and space belong to Diversified Aerospace and Defense.

nodes.name: Defense and Space Systems
nodes.description: Primarily develops military platforms, defense equipment, satellites, or space launch systems.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude civilian aircraft-led companies and diversified aerospace groups.

nodes.name: Diversified Aerospace and Defense
nodes.description: Explicitly operates both commercial aircraft and substantial defense or space businesses.
nodes.exclusions: Do not use for an aircraft startup with a single civilian product program.

nodes.name: Machinery
nodes.description: Produces mechanical equipment for industrial or agricultural work.
nodes.exclusions: Electrical power equipment belongs to Electrical Equipment.

nodes.name: Industrial Machinery
nodes.description: Produces factory, process, or production machinery.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude farm machinery and construction/mining equipment.

nodes.name: Agricultural Machinery
nodes.description: Produces tractors, harvesting systems, or other agricultural machinery.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude farm software and consumer garden products.

nodes.name: Construction and Mining Equipment
nodes.description: Produces excavators, loaders, mining machinery, or related heavy equipment.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude construction contractors and industrial factory machinery.

nodes.name: Electrical Equipment
nodes.description: Produces equipment for electrical power, control, or storage.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude semiconductor chips and general computing hardware.

nodes.name: Power Distribution Equipment
nodes.description: Produces transformers, switchgear, or electrical distribution equipment.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude batteries and industrial control systems.

nodes.name: Industrial Controls
nodes.description: Produces industrial automation controls, drives, or control hardware.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude software-only vendors and semiconductor components.

nodes.name: Batteries and Energy Storage
nodes.description: Produces batteries or integrated electrical energy storage systems.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude power generation utilities and storage software-only suppliers.

nodes.name: Construction and Engineering
nodes.description: Delivers built-environment construction or engineering services.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude equipment manufacturers and property-only investment firms.

nodes.name: Building Construction
nodes.description: Constructs residential or commercial buildings.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude civil infrastructure and design-only engineering.

nodes.name: Civil Infrastructure Construction
nodes.description: Constructs roads, bridges, utilities, or other civil infrastructure.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude building construction and design-only consulting.

nodes.name: Engineering and Design Services
nodes.description: Provides engineering design, planning, or technical consultancy for physical projects.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude IT consulting and contractors primarily executing construction.

nodes.name: Transportation and Logistics
nodes.description: Moves passengers or goods or coordinates logistics.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude vehicle and aircraft manufacturers.

nodes.name: Passenger Transportation
nodes.description: Operates transportation services for passengers.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude freight transport, booking-only platforms, and hotels.

nodes.name: Freight Transportation
nodes.description: Primarily operates vehicles, aircraft, ships, or rail assets to transport goods.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude coordination-only freight forwarders and warehouse-led services.

nodes.name: Logistics and Warehousing
nodes.description: Primarily coordinates freight, fulfillment, storage, or supply-chain services.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude businesses primarily operating line-haul transportation assets.

nodes.name: Food
nodes.description: Develops, produces, or markets edible food products.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude beverages, restaurants, and retailers merely reselling food.

nodes.name: Packaged Foods
nodes.description: Supplies prepared meals, pantry staples, or mixed packaged food portfolios.
nodes.exclusions: Specialist snacks/confectionery and dairy/alternatives use their dedicated categories.

nodes.name: Snacks and Confectionery
nodes.description: Specializes in snack foods, candy, or confectionery.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude broad mixed food portfolios.

nodes.name: Dairy and Alternative Foods
nodes.description: Specializes in dairy foods or plant-based food substitutes.
nodes.exclusions: Packaged drinks belong to Beverages; exclude broad mixed food portfolios.

nodes.name: Beverages
nodes.description: Develops, produces, or markets packaged drinks or beverage brands.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude beverage equipment and third-party-only retailers.

nodes.name: Nonalcoholic Beverages
nodes.description: Supplies nonalcoholic drinks including water, soft drinks, ready-to-drink tea, coffee, or energy drinks.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude alcoholic drinks and dry coffee/tea specialists without a ready-to-drink focus.

nodes.name: Alcoholic Beverages
nodes.description: Primarily supplies beer, wine, spirits, or other alcoholic drinks.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude nonalcoholic-focused portfolios.

nodes.name: Coffee and Tea Products
nodes.description: Specializes in roasted coffee, beans, ground coffee, or dry tea products for preparation.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude cafes and ready-to-drink beverage-focused brands.

nodes.name: Apparel and Footwear
nodes.description: Develops or markets clothing, footwear, or personal accessories.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude retailers only reselling third-party brands.

nodes.name: Apparel
nodes.description: Primarily supplies clothing or garments.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude footwear-led and accessory-led brands.

nodes.name: Footwear
nodes.description: Primarily supplies shoes or other footwear.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude apparel-led portfolios.

nodes.name: Accessories and Bags
nodes.description: Primarily supplies bags, luggage, belts, or fashion accessories.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude clothing-led and footwear-led brands.

nodes.name: Household Products
nodes.description: Supplies products for household furnishing, maintenance, or use.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude personal care and beauty products.

nodes.name: Home Furnishings
nodes.description: Supplies furniture, home textiles, or decorative household items.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude powered appliances and cleaning products.

nodes.name: Household Appliances
nodes.description: Supplies powered appliances for domestic tasks.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude computing hardware and industrial equipment.

nodes.name: Household Cleaning Products
nodes.description: Supplies household detergents, cleaners, or cleaning consumables.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude personal hygiene and industrial cleaning services.

nodes.name: Personal Care and Beauty
nodes.description: Supplies non-prescription personal care, hygiene, or cosmetic products.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude therapeutic medicines.

nodes.name: Skincare and Cosmetics
nodes.description: Primarily supplies skincare or cosmetic products.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude prescription treatments, haircare-led, and hygiene-led portfolios.

nodes.name: Haircare
nodes.description: Primarily supplies hair cleaning, conditioning, coloring, or styling products.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude salon services and general cosmetics-led portfolios.

nodes.name: Personal Hygiene
nodes.description: Primarily supplies oral care, deodorants, or personal hygiene consumables.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude household cleaners and cosmetic-led products.

nodes.name: Software
nodes.description: Develops and supplies reusable application or security software to external users.
nodes.exclusions: Dedicated payment platforms belong to Financial Services; hosted computing capacity belongs to Cloud and Data Infrastructure. For a whole company with multiple substantial technology businesses and no supported single primary specialist activity, use the applicable Diversified Technology path. A matching division alone does not justify this category for the whole company.

nodes.name: Customer Relationship Software
nodes.description: Primarily supports sales, customer service, marketing, or customer relationship workflows.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude product development planning and security software.

nodes.name: Work and Product Management Software
nodes.description: Primarily supports project planning, issue tracking, collaboration, or product development coordination.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude CRM-led and security-focused products.

nodes.name: Cybersecurity Software
nodes.description: Primarily supplies software protecting systems, identities, networks, or data.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude managed IT services and generic project tools.

nodes.name: Computing Hardware
nodes.description: Develops or supplies physical computing devices or systems.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude semiconductor components and non-computing household appliances. For a whole company with multiple substantial technology businesses and no supported single primary specialist activity, use the applicable Diversified Technology path. A matching division alone does not justify this category for the whole company.

nodes.name: Personal Computing Devices
nodes.description: Supplies computers, tablets, or personal computing endpoints.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude server-led and network-equipment-led businesses.

nodes.name: Servers and Storage Hardware
nodes.description: Supplies server systems or physical data-storage equipment.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude rented cloud capacity and semiconductor-only products.

nodes.name: Network Equipment
nodes.description: Supplies physical routers, switches, or networking systems.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude telecom operators and software-only security tools.

nodes.name: Semiconductors
nodes.description: Designs or manufactures semiconductor chips or equipment for chip production.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude complete computing systems. For a whole company with multiple substantial technology businesses and no supported single primary specialist activity, use the applicable Diversified Technology path. A matching division alone does not justify this category for the whole company.

nodes.name: Fabless Chip Design
nodes.description: Designs semiconductor chips while outsourcing wafer fabrication.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude foundries and integrated chip manufacturers.

nodes.name: Chip Manufacturing
nodes.description: Fabricates semiconductor wafers or chips, including foundries and integrated manufacturers.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude fabless designers and equipment suppliers.

nodes.name: Semiconductor Equipment
nodes.description: Supplies machinery or process equipment for semiconductor fabrication.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude chip manufacturers and general industrial machinery.

nodes.name: IT Services
nodes.description: Provides labor- or service-led implementation, development, or management of IT systems.
nodes.exclusions: Reusable product-led software belongs to Software. For a whole company with multiple substantial technology businesses and no supported single primary specialist activity, use the applicable Diversified Technology path. A matching division alone does not justify this category for the whole company.

nodes.name: IT Consulting and Integration
nodes.description: Advises on or integrates enterprise IT systems.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude bespoke development-led and ongoing managed-operations-led firms.

nodes.name: Custom Software Development
nodes.description: Builds bespoke software for individual client requirements.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude reusable software products and general integration consulting.

nodes.name: Managed IT Services
nodes.description: Provides ongoing operation, support, or management of customer IT environments.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude self-service cloud infrastructure and project-only consulting.

nodes.name: Cloud and Data Infrastructure
nodes.description: Supplies hosted computing, storage, data platforms, or data-center capacity.
nodes.exclusions: Running an application in the cloud does not make it infrastructure. For a whole company with multiple substantial technology businesses and no supported single primary specialist activity, use the applicable Diversified Technology path. A matching division alone does not justify this category for the whole company.

nodes.name: Cloud Compute Infrastructure
nodes.description: Rents general-purpose computing, storage, or networking resources as a service.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude application SaaS and physical colocation-only operators.

nodes.name: Managed Data Platforms
nodes.description: Provides managed database, warehouse, or data-processing infrastructure.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude workflow applications and general-purpose compute providers.

nodes.name: Data Centers and Colocation
nodes.description: Operates facilities providing rack space, power, cooling, or colocation for computing equipment.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude cloud software services without a facilities-led offering.

nodes.name: Diversified Technology
nodes.description: Operates multiple substantial technology product or platform businesses at the company level, rather than a single specialist offering.
nodes.exclusions: Do not use merely because a specialist sells multiple related products. Require evidence of distinct substantial businesses.

nodes.name: Diversified Internet Platforms
nodes.description: Operates a broad consumer internet ecosystem spanning search, digital content or media, advertising, and additional technology platforms such as cloud services. Evidence describes multiple substantial businesses of the target as a whole.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude standalone cloud providers and enterprise software ecosystems without a substantial consumer internet and advertising business. Do not classify the whole ecosystem solely as cloud compute.

nodes.name: Diversified Software and Computing Platforms
nodes.description: Operates a broad software and computing ecosystem spanning operating systems or productivity applications, cloud infrastructure, and additional businesses such as devices or gaming. Evidence describes multiple substantial businesses of the target as a whole.
nodes.exclusions: Exclude specialist application vendors, standalone cloud providers, and ecosystems primarily organized around consumer internet search, media, and advertising.
